Asset type: Silent Storm diffuse UV texture atlas.
Input image1 is the exact original edit target. Image2 is a faithful nearest-neighbor 4x enlargement of the same full source canvas solely for precise layout guidance. Reconstruct this SAME full canvas as a faithful HD texture with fine material detail. Do not render an object or scene. Full tall1:4 canvas, target256x1024. Preserve EXACT full-canvas campfire log UV sheet, not an assembled fire. Keep their different sizes and original positions; do not add any other round log ends. Preserve bark grain longitudinally, black voids, the existing narrow vertical charred strip in upper center with tiny red/yellow embers, the lower broad dark charred area with sparse embers, and the source short log end along left edge near bottom. Do not add flame, smoke, glowing coals outside original marks, new logs, or move/crop any island. Refine bark and log end rings conservatively with original small-scale irregular texture.
uv_registration_reason: Privately reviewed uniform side letterboxing of the same full opaque camp log/bark atlas.
